what: crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit/script.rs script_unit (no-fallback): (1) blaze_build_script::env now refuses a Unit with an empty field cargo always fills (Unit::check: manifest dir/path, script, OUT_DIR, CARGO, RUSTC, RUSTDOC, name, version, TARGET, HOST, OPT_LEVEL) and a non-semver version, so `manifest_dir ... unwrap_or_default()` (line ~137) and `program: ...outputs.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default()` in script/pure.rs run_of (~line 170) now surface as typed errors at env(); make them errors where they are made instead. (2) `sysroot_libdir: PathBuf::new()` means blaze has no sysroot library dir; blaze-build-script now adds nothing for an empty one (an empty LD_LIBRARY_PATH entry is the cwd). Better: make DylibSearch::sysroot_libdir an Option<PathBuf> and set None here; tell no-fallback-link-scripts (or usercode) to flip the type in crates/blaze-build-script/src/unit.rs + env.rs in the same round. (3) `jobs: available_parallelism().map_or(1, ..)` guesses NUM_JOBS when the count cannot be read.
